_note: Hand-labelled promo moments, one or two per episode, picked by reading the scripts. Drafted with AI assistance and checked by hand; an editor should replace or extend these. A moment counts as found if a promo in that episode covers at least 50% of it (or the moment covers 50% of the promo). 'dev' moments were labelled first and used while building; 'heldout' moments were labelled later, before looking at any engine's picks for those episodes, and were never used for tuning.
